About the Team

OpenAI’s 1P Hardware Systems team operates at the intersection of Hardware Engineering, Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Deployment, and Finance to translate infrastructure demand into an executable systems plan.

The Planning Lead connects system demand and deployment timing to site and configuration requirements, power availability, XPU needs, hardware supply commitments, manufacturing capacity, and site readiness.

About the Role

OpenAI is seeking a 1P Hardware Systems Planning Lead to own the integrated demand, supply, and deployment plan for our 1P AI infrastructure systems. This role will connect infrastructure demand and site power availability to system configurations, XPU requirements, and hardware supply commitments—creating a single, actionable view of whether our deployment plan can be met.

You will establish the planning mechanisms that allow teams to see what changed, understand the impact, and act quickly when demand, supply, configuration, site readiness, or power timing moves. You will work across Hardware Engineering, Infrastructure, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing, Manufacturing, Deployment, and Finance to identify gaps early and drive recovery plans to closure.

This is a highly cross-functional role for someone who combines systems-level thinking, strong analytical judgment, and rigorous program execution. The ideal candidate can turn complex and changing inputs into a clear operating plan, surface the decisions that matter, and drive accountability across teams without relying on formal authority. Success also requires strong communication judgment: the ability to align cross-functional teams, brief leadership at a concise and decision-oriented level, and go deep into the underlying assumptions, dependencies, risks, and recovery plans when needed.

Responsibilities

- Integrated Planning - Own the integrated planning process for 1P hardware systems, connecting system demand, deployment timing, site and configuration requirements, power availability, XPU needs, and supply commitments.

- Maintain a clear, decision-ready supply plan that shows changes from the prior plan; weekly pull-ins and push-outs; site, deployment, and system-configuration impacts; power availability assumptions and timing; system demand and corresponding XPU requirements; current supplier and manufacturing commitments; gaps between forecast, requirements, and committed supply; and recovery actions with accountable owners and target closure dates.

- Validate that the end-to-end supply plan is executable, including the timing and dependencies across components, XPU availability, system integration, factory capacity, site readiness, and deployment.

- Operating Cadence & Change Management - Lead a weekly deployment and supply review focused on material changes, emerging risks, required decisions, and recovery-plan execution.

- Publish and maintain a weekly delta report that clearly explains what changed, why it changed, and the downstream impact to deployments, sites, configurations, power, and supply.

- Track forecast-versus-commit gaps at a weekly level, identify the underlying constraints, and drive recovery plans with named owners and dates.

- Coordinate the biweekly end-to-end supply picture update for leadership and key stakeholders, including the latest system forecast; how the forecast aligns with site power availability and timing; current supply commitments; weekly gaps to commit; and the plan and timing to close each gap.

- Cross-Functional Execution & Risk Management - Partner with Hardware Engineering and Infrastructure teams to translate roadmap, configuration, and deployment changes into updated system and XPU requirements.

- Work through the Supply Chain team to pressure-test commitments with manufacturing partners and suppliers, understand constraints, and establish credible recovery paths.

- Anticipate supply and deployment risks, develop scenarios and tradeoffs, and provide crisp recommendations to senior leaders.

- Process & Operational Scaling - Build scalable planning models, reporting standards, and operating mechanisms that improve forecast accuracy, change control, traceability, and executive decision-making as 1P infrastructure scales.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

- Significant experience in hardware systems planning, supply planning, program management, operations, or a related role supporting complex, high-volume technology products or infrastructure.

- Strong understanding of the dependencies among hardware demand, component supply, manufacturing capacity, system configurations, site readiness, power availability, and deployment schedules.

- Experience building and managing integrated demand-and-supply plans at weekly granularity, including forecast changes, supply commits, gaps, scenarios, and recovery actions.

- Demonstrated ability to pressure-test whether a plan is executable rather than simply consolidating inputs from different teams.

- Exceptional analytical skills and the ability to translate complex datasets and technical dependencies into clear insights, decisions, and actions.

- Strong program leadership, including experience establishing operating cadences, driving cross-functional accountability, and closing issues across organizations.

- Demonstrated experience communicating effectively across cross-functional teams and with senior leadership, with the judgment to tailor the level of detail to the audience—distilling complex issues into concise, decision-ready updates while going deep on assumptions, dependencies, risks, and recovery plans when needed.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, high-ambiguity environment where requirements, priorities, and constraints evolve quickly.

- High ownership, sound judgment, and a bias toward surfacing risks early and driving them through resolution.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AI infrastructure, hyperscale data centers, or accelerator systems.

- Experience with semiconductors, server or rack manufacturing, or complex hardware supply chains.

What Success Looks Like

- A single, trusted view of 1P hardware system demand, supply commitments, deployment timing, and associated gaps.

- Clear weekly visibility into changes, pull-ins, push-outs, and their impact on sites, configurations, power, systems, and XPUs.

- Early identification of risks to the deployment plan, with quantified impact and actionable recovery paths.

- Work through SCPM and strategic sourcing to ensure every material gap has a clear recovery plan, accountable owner, target date, and escalation path.

- Forecast, supply, manufacturing, site-readiness, and power assumptions remain aligned across teams.

- Leadership receives a concise, consistent, and decision-oriented biweekly view of the end-to-end supply picture.

- Planning processes and tools scale with the pace, volume, and complexity of OpenAI’s 1P infrastructure roadmap.

Are you passionate about product safety and want to make a global impact? AWS Global Trade and Product Compliance (GTPC) is seeking a Hardware Compliance Engineer to help shape our safety engineering efforts across our rapidly expanding data center infrastructure.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end safety compliance lifecycle — from early-stage design engagement through final certification — for AWS hardware spanning artificial intelligence, machine learning, power distribution, and cooling systems deployed in data centers worldwide. You'll serve as the technical authority on safety standards for data center racks, computes, servers or networking. partnering directly with product development teams, ODM design partners, test agencies, and legal stakeholders to deliver compliant products on tight timelines.

This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence design decisions, drive first-time-pass test outcomes, and build scalable processes that keep pace with AWS's growth. You'll also bring complementary expertise in one or more compliance domains –– medium and low voltage switch gear or Functional Safety.

If you thrive in ambiguity, love solving complex technical problems, and want to shape how the world's largest cloud provider approaches product safety, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own safety compliance strategy for new product introduction (NPI) and sustaining programs, identifying applicable requirements across global markets and driving execution from concept through certification.
- Partner with hardware development teams during design reviews to proactively identify safety risks, recommend design modifications, and ensure first-time test pass rates.
- Serve as the primary technical interface with Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTLs) and Notified Bodies, managing test plans, resolving findings, and securing timely approvals.
- Dive deep into technical issues with ODM design partners — performing root cause analysis, defining corrective actions, and implementing preventative measures to avoid recurrence.
- Build and maintain a scalable compliance framework including templates, checklists, and process documentation that enables the team to support AWS's expanding hardware portfolio.
- Develop and track metrics that provide visibility into certification pipeline health, cycle times, and risk areas — using data to prioritize improvement initiatives and communicate status to leadership.
- Stay current on evolving global safety regulations and proactively assess impact to AWS's product roadmap.

A day in the life
You will review test reports from an agency partner, identifying a non-conformance on a GPU sled and working with the ODM to develop a corrective action plan. You join a design review for a next-generation cooling system, flagging a potential Machinery Directive concern and proposing an alternative approach. You update your certification tracker and prepare a risk summary for your manager's leadership review. You collaborate with a teammate on a new process template that will cut weeks off future program timelines.

About the team
AWS Global Trade and Product Compliance (GTPC) ensures that the infrastructure hardware powering AWS services meets all applicable regulatory and certification requirements across every country where AWS operates — and where we're expanding next. Our Product Compliance Engineering team is the technical engine behind this mission, combining deep domain expertise with a builder's mindset to deliver safe and compliant products at the speed and scale AWS demands.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking an experienced enablement professional to build our Sales Leader Enablement program. As a key member of the GTM Productivity team, you will be responsible for designing the onboarding, training, and reinforcement programs that ensure our sales managers ramp quickly, lead their teams effectively, and drive consistent sales process across a rapidly growing global sales organization. You will define what great sales leadership looks like at Anthropic and build the infrastructure to develop it at scale.

You will work at the intersection of sales leadership, product, operations, and our field teams to translate complex AI concepts, sales processes, and systems into clear programs. This is a ground floor opportunity to architect a sales leader enablement function from scratch. The right person will combine deep sales methodology and coaching expertise with credibility in front of executives, program building instincts, and a bias toward measurable outcomes.

Key responsibilities

• Design and build a scalable onboarding and ongoing development program for sales leadership
• Roll out and reinforce a unified sales methodology across the global sales team, securing executive sponsorship and defining what is expected of each leadership level to drive adoption
• Build the reinforcement system that embeds methodology and process into manager coaching cadences, deal reviews, pipeline inspection, and forecasting
• Define and measure leading indicators of manager and team effectiveness
• Partner with Product, Marketing, Operations, and other teams to ensure managers receive timely, well-tailored messaging, content, and training on new releases and evolving use cases
• Serve as a trusted advisor to sales leadership on team productivity, coaching effectiveness, and leadership development
• Leverage Claude and advanced technologies to deliver personalized, just-in-time training and scale the program beyond in-person engagement

Minimum qualifications

• Direct experience rolling out and reinforcing a sales methodology across a distributed sales team, including training managers to coach to it
• Program management experience, including building enablement programs from the ground up in a fast-growing, ambiguous environment
• Strong presentation and facilitation skills, with experience delivering training or coaching in front of both managers and executives

Preferred qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales leadership development, sales management, or a related customer-facing role within AI/ML or enterprise technology organizations
• A track record of earning buy-in from senior sales leaders and frontline managers, and driving stakeholder alignment with executive audiences
• Strong analytical skills with a data-driven approach to measuring ramp, productivity, and program effectiveness
• Empathy for sellers and sales leaders, with an understanding of the demands of the role and a partnership-oriented approach to conflict and disagreement
• A proactive, resourceful approach, combining strategic vision with a willingness to build and execute hands-on
• Prior frontline sales management experience
• Experience at an AI company or high-growth technology organization that has scaled a sales leadership team
• Experience using or building applications on top of Claude or similar AI tools to automate and personalize training

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$310,000—$360,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. 회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

Chez nous, l’attitude est aussi importante que le talent. On ne craint pas l’échec puisque pour nous, il n’existe pas. On essaie toutes sortes de choses et si le résultat n’est pas bon, on apprend et on recommence. Pour coller à cette philosophie, nous avons besoin de personnes responsables qui ont le goût de grandir, de s’épanouir et d’accompagner des marques d’ici dans leurs réflexions créatives. Si tu es un.e joueur.euse reconnu.e pour ta pensée stratégique et ta capacité à bâtir des relations de confiance avec tes partenaires internes et tes clients, on est fait pour s’entendre et on te propose un poste de superviseur.e de comptes. Tu es une personne curieuse et à l’affût des dernières tendances du milieu. ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is an exciting opportunity to be the face and heartbeat of ElevenLabs’ Warsaw office! We are looking for a dedicated lead to anchor our Warsaw space. This office serves as the home for our rapidly growing Poland team and a central hub for the Poland AI community.

As our Warsaw Workplace Experience, you will be the "go-to" person for the Warsaw team, driving the office and culture. You’ll keep the daily logistics moving, assist with the launch of our new building in the heart of the city, and ensure our office is a place where people love to work. This role is perfect for a proactive, high-energy individual who enjoys being at the center of the action and wants to grow their career in a fast-paced AI company.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Be the Warsaw Hub: Serve as the primary point of contact for the local team and all new joiners, welcoming people to the space and ensuring everyone – staff, guests, and candidates – feels at home from day one.

- Keep Operations Running: Manage daily logistics including post, communal areas, meeting room readiness, and vendor coordination (cleaners, catering, maintenance) to maintain a world-class environment.

- Own the Office Culture: Drive the vibe of the space through snack and coffee selections, team lunches, birthday celebrations, and social rituals that make the office somewhere people love to be.

- Support Events & Visitors: Help execute on-site events such as AI hackathons and evening meetups, while providing a warm and professional welcome experience for all external guests and partners.

REQUIREMENTS

- Based in Warsaw, able to be in the office 5 days a week.

- Strong operational expertise in managing the day-to-day running of a high visibility office. Thrives in high pressure environments requiring solid judgement and quick decision making.

- Experience acting as the primary point of contact for building management, coordinating with vendors, and overseeing office maintenance and supplies.

- Ability to communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, from senior executives and legal partners to vendors and office guests, ensuring a professional and welcoming environment.

- A proactive and forward-thinking approach, with a proven ability to anticipate needs, identify inefficiencies, and implement new processes to improve workflow in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience in fostering a positive and productive office environment, including planning and executing office-wide events and negotiating with vendors to ensure high-quality service and cost-effectiveness.

WHY THIS ROLE?

This is a “foot in the door” at one of the world’s leading AI companies. You’ll have the autonomy to shape the local culture and the opportunity to learn office operations and facility management from the ground up as we scale our Polish presence.

LOCATION

This role is based full-time at our Warsaw office, 5 days a week.
